description: Third Generation Simulation Data (TGSIM) I-395 Trajectories is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "Third Generation Simulation Data (TGSIM) I-395 Trajectories. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1404222". The main dataset is a 232 MB file of trajectory data (I395-final.csv) that contains position, speed, and acceleration data for non-automated passenger cars, trucks, buses, and automated vehicles on an expressway within an urban environment. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 10 columns, among them lane_kf, speed_kf, time, xloc_kf, yloc_kf, acceleration_kf. The portal shows 2025-05-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation:. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
